From: r.mbeki@ferngrovefoods.example
Subject: Bulk pricing inquiry
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am the purchasing manager at Ferngrove Foods, a regional producer of jams and preserves. We currently order roughly four thousand glass jars per month from a supplier in another province, but rising freight costs have led us to look for a partner closer to our facility in Kelmore.

Could you send me your bulk pricing for 250-milliliter jars with metal lids, along with your minimum order quantity and typical lead time? If you offer samples, I would also like to request two or three so that our production team can confirm the lids seal correctly on our equipment.
One further point: our labels are applied by machine, so the jars must have a smooth, unembossed surface. Please confirm whether your standard product meets that requirement before quoting.
I would appreciate a reply by Friday, as we are reviewing three suppliers this month.
Regards,
Rethabile Mbeki, Purchasing Manager

passage: 【文件】報導
KELMORE — The city council voted on Tuesday to extend the number 7 tram line by four kilometres, connecting the riverside district to the industrial park east of the highway.

The project, estimated at 62 million dollars, will be funded jointly by the city and the provincial transport authority. Construction is scheduled to begin next spring and to finish within three years.

Supporters argue the extension will ease pressure on the two bus routes that currently serve the area, both of which regularly run above capacity during morning hours. Roughly nine thousand people commute into the industrial park each weekday.

Not everyone welcomed the decision. Several business owners along Chandler Street said the construction would obstruct access to their shops for extended periods. Council member Ida Brennan responded that the city would offer a rent subsidy to affected ground-floor businesses during the work.
A detailed route map will be published on the city website next month.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the article?
choices: A change to city parking rules
The opening of a new industrial park
questions.note: 主旨題，第一段就給了：council voted to extend the tram line。

questions.q: The word "ease" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
questions.note: 同義字題。★ 一定要回原句看用法：ease pressure on the bus routes = 減輕壓力，所以是 reduce。★ ease 最常見的意思是「舒適、容易」，但這裡是動詞「減輕」——同義字題考的就是這種一字多義。

questions.q: Why do some business owners oppose the project?
choices: They expect customers will have trouble reaching them.
They believe the cost is too high.
They prefer an expanded bus service.
They were not consulted in advance.
questions.note: 第四段 the construction would obstruct access to their shops。★ (B) 的金額文中有提到，但沒有人以此反對 —— 這是典型的「數字有出現但不是理由」陷阱。

questions.q: What does Ms. Brennan say the city will provide?
questions.note: 第四段末 a rent subsidy to affected ground-floor businesses。

passage: 【文件】網路評論
Reviewed by: G. Achterberg   ★★★☆☆   Verified purchase
Product: Kestrel 4L Insulated Lunch Carrier

I bought this to replace a cheaper bag that fell apart after one winter, and on durability the Kestrel is a clear step up. The outer fabric has held up to daily use for four months with no fraying at the seams, and the zipper still runs smoothly.

Insulation is where it gets mixed. A cold pack keeps things properly chilled for about five hours, which covers a normal workday. The manufacturer claims eight, and I have not come close to that even in a cool office.
The shoulder strap is the part I would change. It is not padded and digs in once the bag is full. I ended up using the side handle instead, which defeats the purpose of buying a bag with a strap.
Would I buy it again? Probably yes, but at a sale price rather than full price.

questions.q: What does the reviewer praise about the product?
questions.note: 第三段 no fraying at the seams, zipper still runs smoothly = 做工紮實。★ 另外三項在文中都是被批評或未提及的。

questions.q: What does the reviewer suggest about the manufacturer's claim?
choices: It overstates how long the bag stays cold.
It applies only to certain models.
questions.note: The manufacturer claims eight, and I have not come close to that。★ 推論題：實測五小時 vs 宣稱八小時 → 誇大。

questions.q: Why does the reviewer use the side handle?
choices: The handle is easier to clean.
The bag is too heavy to carry.
questions.note: It is not padded and digs in once the bag is full。

passage: 【文件】網站常見問題
BRIGHTLEAF GARDEN SUPPLY — DELIVERY QUESTIONS
How long does delivery take?

Orders placed before 2 P.M. on a business day are dispatched the same day. Standard delivery arrives in three to five business days; express arrives the next business day for an additional 12 dollars.
Do you deliver live plants?

Yes, but live plants ship Monday through Wednesday only, so that they are not held in a warehouse over the weekend. If your order contains both plants and other items, the entire order ships on the next available plant shipping day.
What if something arrives damaged?
Photograph the item and the packaging, then submit a claim through your account within seven days of delivery. Replacements are sent at no cost. We do not require you to return damaged goods.
Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
Only if the order has not yet been dispatched. Contact us by phone; address changes cannot be made by email.

choices: To avoid being stored over the weekend
